name: summary_df

Reinst/VarRt demoted a130: no bespoke exhibits.

name: stats_df
description: Single source of truth for moments (component x measure x view)
notes: Canonical moment store; summary_df/validation_df read from it. On PnL it is a PROPERTY: rows = ledger as (View, Line) / (Step, View, Line) on a tower; columns EX/SD/CV/Skew + the ladder: kappa SCENARIO STATES E[row | result == x_q] under a136 kappa headers (foot exactly; a134 [Kappa-Scenario-Percentiles]) exactly when the ledger shares one source; no-shared-atoms ledgers (massive route; the kernel stitched mode) stay MARGINAL under plain P01..P99 headers -- since a141 every DecL xpnl walk is per-atom (gross atoms, or the occurrence joint) so it carries the footing kappa ladder; tower grand step key is 'All' (a141). Reinst/VarRt demoted a130 (exact engine private).
